newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Liability orientation debate postponed at least to Jan 29.
newsitem.headline: Liability orientation debate postponed at least to Jan 29.

text.p: The European Commission has postponed until at least January 29 an orientation debate on environmental liability, a Commission official said.
The file, prepared by Environment Commissioner Ritt Bjerregaard, was originally to have been tackled on Wednesday.
It presents three options for an EU-level approach to legal issues concerning land protection and contaminated land clean-up.
The debate was delayed for want of sufficient preparatory work in the weekly meeting of chef de cabinets, the official said.
